title: Anyone feel nostalgic when you wake up?
content: I always feel like this in the morning after I go to MallWorld. It's like a yearning to go back and a feeling of that being home and not this. I feel like there is such depth to everything there and I feel like it is truly another reality or dimension I exist in. It is this town, I can move freely there, either up the hills on a red bus, or to my "School/Mall", I take classes there, It feels so familiar... There is a train station and a highway too, I love them so much My favourite place in MallWorld is probably the market. It is an underground market in between two huge hotels. You get out of the hotel and go down these stairs which will get you to the market place, you can find all sorts of animals and black magic stuff there, and it is very crowded with all sorts of creatures The mall is huge and it has a cinema/concert hall in the middle of it There is also an outside venue with a huge mountain/slide and there are usually bands playing there Anyways I always feel like I want to go back, every time, I just want to know what that place is!
